decisions: Normal happy-path Standard Action progression should be deterministic and must not require fresh Owner authorization at apply/archive boundaries.
An active Change with no current Action starts at explore; a prepared current Action A can only continue as A and Policy must not introduce resumed/retry semantics.
Terminal Author outcomes advance only on exact PASS; terminal Reviewer outcomes branch only on exact approved or changes-requested; unknown outcomes block.
Policy computes legality independently from reported nextBoundary; a conflicting reported boundary should produce a fail-closed diagnosis rather than override Policy.
Owner-authorized deviation is bounded to revise-family correction at the current or an earlier reached stage and must not permit forward-skip of independent Review.
Archive completion yields a checkpoint-evaluation boundary only; actual Git checkpoint permission remains deferred to the mutation/checkpoint Change.
Policy remains a pure decision seam and never executes the selected Action or mutates repository state.
